``````{=html}
<div class="rttt-widget" data-widget="nv-update" data-beats="6">
<div role="region" id="nv-update" aria-label="Animated walkthrough of one TTT update-then-apply step">
<style>
  #nv-update {
    --tg-dark:  #326355;
    --tg-mid:   #7FA79A;
    --tg-fill:  #E6F0EC;
    --ink:      #222;
    --muted:    #555;
    --faint:    #888;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto,
                 Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    color: var(--ink);
    max-width: 940px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }
  #nv-update .rttt-eyebrow {
    font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; font-weight: 600;
    color: var(--tg-dark); text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 6px;
  }
  #nv-update h3 { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 650; margin: 0 0 10px; color: var(--ink); }
  #nv-update .rttt-tagline {
    font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--muted);
    margin: 0 0 18px; max-width: 800px;
  }
  #nv-update .rttt-var { font-family: Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif; font-style: italic; }
  #nv-update .rttt-fig { position: relative; max-width: 860px; margin: 0 auto; }
  #nv-update .rttt-fig > svg { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
  #nv-update .rttt-caption { min-height: 3.2em; margin: 10px 2px 4px; }
  #nv-update .rttt-cap-row { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; }
  #nv-update .rttt-pill {
    font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase; border-radius: 4px; padding: 2px 8px;
    flex: 0 0 auto; transform: translateY(-1px);
    background: #EFEFEF; color: #666;
  }
  #nv-update .rttt-pill.g  { background: var(--tg-fill); color: var(--tg-dark); }
  #nv-update .rttt-pill.gd { background: var(--tg-dark); color: #fff; }
  #nv-update .rttt-cap-line { font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink); line-height: 1.5; }
  #nv-update .rttt-cap-line sub { font-size: 70%; }
  #nv-update .rttt-controls { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin: 8px 0 10px; }
  #nv-update .rttt-controls button {
    font: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; color: #444; background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; cursor: pointer;
  }
  #nv-update .rttt-controls button:hover { background: #f7f7f7; }
  #nv-update .rttt-controls button:focus-visible,
  #nv-update .rttt-controls select:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--tg-mid); outline-offset: 1px; }
  #nv-update .rttt-controls select {
    font: inherit; font-size: 12.5px; color: #444; background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 6px; margin-left: auto;
  }
  #nv-update .rttt-foot { font-size: 12px; color: var(--faint); margin: 8px 2px 0; line-height: 1.5; }
</style>

<p class="rttt-eyebrow">RoboTTT &middot; Mechanism</p>
<h3>One timestep, up close: update then apply</h3>
<p class="rttt-tagline">
  Inside a TTT layer the same small network is written to and then read from,
  once per timestep. Equations 1 and 2 are these five moves.
</p>

<div class="rttt-fig" role="img"
     aria-label="A single TTT timestep: keys and values arrive, the fast model predicts, the error is measured, one gradient step updates the fast weights, and the query reads the updated model">
  <svg id="nv-stage" viewBox="0 0 700 228" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet"
       aria-hidden="true" focusable="false"></svg>
</div>

<div class="rttt-caption">
  <div class="rttt-cap-row">
    <span class="rttt-pill" id="nv-pill">arrive</span>
    <span class="rttt-cap-line" id="nv-cap"></span>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="rttt-controls">
  <button id="nv-play" aria-label="Pause animation">Pause</button>
  <button id="nv-step" aria-label="Step to next beat">Step</button>
  <button id="nv-restart" aria-label="Restart animation">Restart</button>
  <select id="nv-speed" aria-label="Playback speed">
    <option value="0.5">0.5&times;</option>
    <option value="1" selected>1&times;</option>
    <option value="1.5">1.5&times;</option>
    <option value="2">2&times;</option>
  </select>
</div>

<p class="rttt-foot">
  Built for this talk in the project page's visual language; not part of the paper.
</p>

</div>

<script>
/* NV-3 "update then apply" - built for PR-561 in the RoboTTT project-page
   visual language. Same stepper contract as the lifted widgets:
   Play / Step / Restart / Speed, IntersectionObserver auto-pause,
   prefers-reduced-motion honoured. */
(function () {
  "use strict";

  var root = document.getElementById("nv-update");
  if (!root) return;
  var stage = root.querySelector("#nv-stage");
  if (!stage || stage.dataset.built) return;
  stage.dataset.built = "1";

  var NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
  var DARK = "#326355", MID = "#7FA79A", FILL = "#E6F0EC";
  var INK = "#222", MUTED = "#555", FAINT = "#888";

  function el(name, attrs, parent) {
    var e = document.createElementNS(NS, name);
    for (var k in attrs) e.setAttribute(k, attrs[k]);
    if (parent) parent.appendChild(e);
    return e;
  }

  /* runs: [text, kind] with kind in "", "v", "sub", "vsub", "sup" */
  function rich(parent, x, y, runs, size, fill, anchor) {
    var t = el("text", {
      x: x, y: y, "font-size": size, fill: fill || INK,
      "text-anchor": anchor || "start"
    }, parent);
    var sub = Math.round(size * 0.68 * 10) / 10, pend = 0;
    runs.forEach(function (r) {
      var kind = r[1] || "", dy, sz;
      if (kind === "sub" || kind === "vsub") {
        dy = size * 0.26 - pend; sz = sub; pend = size * 0.26;
      } else if (kind === "sup") {
        dy = -size * 0.42 - pend; sz = sub; pend = -size * 0.42;
      } else {
        dy = -pend; sz = size; pend = 0;
      }
      var s = el("tspan", { dy: dy.toFixed(2), "font-size": sz }, t);
      if (kind === "v" || kind === "vsub") s.setAttribute("class", "rttt-var");
      s.textContent = r[0];
    });
    return t;
  }

  function chip(parent, x, y, w, h, stroke, fill) {
    return el("rect", {
      x: x, y: y, width: w, height: h, rx: 6,
      fill: fill, stroke: stroke, "stroke-width": 1.6
    }, parent);
  }

  /* ---------------------------------------------------------------- defs */
  var defs = el("defs", {}, stage);
  [["nvD", DARK], ["nvM", MID], ["nvF", FAINT]].forEach(function (p) {
    var m = el("marker", {
      id: p[0], viewBox: "0 0 10 10", refX: 8.5, refY: 5,
      markerWidth: 6.5, markerHeight: 6.5, orient: "auto-start-reverse"
    }, defs);
    el("path", { d: "M0,0.8 L9,5 L0,9.2 z", fill: p[1] }, m);
  });

  /* --------------------------------------------------------------- build */
  var g = el("g", {}, stage);
  var A = {};   /* animated handles */

  /* left column: the three projections of this timestep */
  el("text", {
    x: 20, y: 32, "font-size": 10.5, fill: FAINT,
    "letter-spacing": ".1em", "font-weight": 600
  }, g).textContent = "STEP t";

  A.kv = el("g", {}, g);
  chip(A.kv, 20, 48, 78, 26, DARK, FILL);
  rich(A.kv, 59, 66, [["K", "v"], ["t", "vsub"]], 15, DARK, "middle");
  chip(A.kv, 20, 84, 78, 26, DARK, FILL);
  rich(A.kv, 59, 102, [["V", "v"], ["t", "vsub"]], 15, DARK, "middle");

  A.q = el("g", {}, g);
  chip(A.q, 20, 134, 78, 26, MID, "#fff");
  rich(A.q, 59, 152, [["Q", "v"], ["t", "vsub"]], 15, DARK, "middle");

  /* middle: the fast model */
  A.boxFill = el("rect", {
    x: 168, y: 44, width: 210, height: 124, rx: 10,
    fill: DARK, "fill-opacity": 0.10
  }, g);
  el("rect", {
    x: 168, y: 44, width: 210, height: 124, rx: 10,
    fill: "none", stroke: DARK, "stroke-width": 1.9
  }, g);
  rich(g, 182, 66, [["f", "v"], ["W", "vsub"]], 15, INK);
  A.wOld = rich(g, 366, 66, [["W", "v"], ["t−1", "sub"]], 14, DARK, "end");
  A.wNew = rich(g, 366, 66, [["W", "v"], ["t", "sub"]], 14, "#12332B", "end");

  A.mlp = el("g", {}, g);
  (function () {
    var cols = [[218, 3], [273, 4], [328, 3]], cy = 122, pts = [];
    cols.forEach(function (c) {
      var n = c[1], span = (n - 1) * 22, arr = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) arr.push([c[0], cy - span / 2 + i * 22]);
      pts.push(arr);
    });
    for (var i = 0; i < pts.length - 1; i++)
      pts[i].forEach(function (a) {
        pts[i + 1].forEach(function (b) {
          el("line", {
            x1: a[0], y1: a[1], x2: b[0], y2: b[1],
            stroke: MID, "stroke-opacity": 0.45, "stroke-width": 1
          }, A.mlp);
        });
      });
    pts.forEach(function (layer, i) {
      layer.forEach(function (p) {
        el("circle", {
          cx: p[0], cy: p[1], r: 6.5, fill: "#fff",
          stroke: i === 1 ? DARK : MID, "stroke-width": 1.6
        }, A.mlp);
      });
    });
  })();

  /* K,V into the box */
  A.arrKV = el("g", {}, g);
  el("path", {
    d: "M98 61 H134 V78 M98 97 H134 V78 M134 78 H162",
    stroke: DARK, "stroke-width": 1.6, fill: "none", "marker-end": "url(#nvD)"
  }, A.arrKV);

  /* Q into the box */
  A.arrQ = el("g", {}, g);
  el("path", {
    d: "M98 147 H134 V140 H162",
    stroke: MID, "stroke-width": 1.6, fill: "none", "marker-end": "url(#nvM)"
  }, A.arrQ);

  /* the gradient step, looping back into the box */
  A.grad = el("g", {}, g);
  el("path", {
    d: "M236 172 C 218 202, 330 202, 310 174",
    stroke: DARK, "stroke-width": 1.8, fill: "none", "marker-end": "url(#nvD)"
  }, A.grad);
  rich(A.grad, 273, 216, [["− η ∇", ""], ["L", ""], ["FW", "sub"]], 12, DARK,
       "middle");

  /* right column: prediction, target, loss, output */
  A.vhat = el("g", {}, g);
  el("path", {
    d: "M378 61 H418", stroke: DARK, "stroke-width": 1.6, fill: "none",
    "marker-end": "url(#nvD)"
  }, A.vhat);
  chip(A.vhat, 424, 48, 116, 26, DARK, "#fff");
  rich(A.vhat, 482, 66, [["v", "v"], ["̂", ""], [" = ", ""], ["f", "v"],
                         ["W", "vsub"], ["(", ""], ["K", "v"], ["t", "vsub"],
                         [")", ""]], 12.5, INK, "middle");

  A.target = el("g", {}, g);
  chip(A.target, 424, 88, 116, 26, MID, FILL);
  rich(A.target, 482, 106, [["V", "v"], ["t", "vsub"], ["  (target)", ""]],
       12.5, MUTED, "middle");
  el("path", {
    d: "M552 55 h8 v52 h-8 M560 81 h10", stroke: FAINT, "stroke-width": 1.2,
    fill: "none"
  }, A.target);
  rich(A.target, 576, 78, [["L", ""], ["FW", "sub"]], 12.5, INK);
  rich(A.target, 576, 94, [["squared gap", ""]], 10.5, FAINT);

  A.out = el("g", {}, g);
  el("path", {
    d: "M378 147 H418", stroke: DARK, "stroke-width": 1.8, fill: "none",
    "marker-end": "url(#nvD)"
  }, A.out);
  chip(A.out, 424, 134, 116, 26, DARK, FILL);
  rich(A.out, 482, 152, [["O", "v"], ["t", "vsub"], [" = ", ""], ["f", "v"],
                         ["W", "vsub"], ["t", "vsub"], ["(", ""], ["Q", "v"],
                         ["t", "vsub"], [")", ""]], 12.5, "#12332B", "middle");

  /* beat 6 badges */
  function badge(x, y, w, label, bg, fg) {
    var grp = el("g", {}, g);
    el("rect", { x: x, y: y, width: w, height: 19, rx: 4, fill: bg }, grp);
    var t = el("text", {
      x: x + w / 2, y: y + 13.5, "font-size": 10, "font-weight": 700,
      "letter-spacing": ".09em", fill: fg, "text-anchor": "middle"
    }, grp);
    t.textContent = label;
    return grp;
  }
  A.write = badge(77, 20, 114, "UPDATE = WRITE", DARK, "#fff");
  A.read = badge(77, 174, 114, "APPLY = READ", FILL, DARK);

  /* --------------------------------------------------------------- beats */
  var BEATS = [
    { pill: "arrive", cls: "g", dur: 3.0,
      cap: "A timestep begins. The key and value for this step arrive: <span class=\"rttt-var\">K</span><sub>t</sub> is what to look up by, <span class=\"rttt-var\">V</span><sub>t</sub> is what should come back." },
    { pill: "predict", cls: "g", dur: 3.4,
      cap: "Run <span class=\"rttt-var\">K</span><sub>t</sub> through the fast model as it currently stands. Its guess is <span class=\"rttt-var\">v&#770;</span>." },
    { pill: "measure", cls: "g", dur: 3.2,
      cap: "Compare that guess with the real <span class=\"rttt-var\">V</span><sub>t</sub>. The squared gap is the fast-weight loss <span class=\"rttt-var\">L</span><sub>FW</sub> - a self-supervised target, no labels involved." },
    { pill: "update", cls: "gd", dur: 3.6,
      cap: "One gradient step on that loss: <span class=\"rttt-var\">W</span><sub>t-1</sub> becomes <span class=\"rttt-var\">W</span><sub>t</sub>. <b>Equation 1.</b> This step runs at training time and at deployment alike." },
    { pill: "apply", cls: "gd", dur: 3.4,
      cap: "Now query the <i>updated</i> model with <span class=\"rttt-var\">Q</span><sub>t</sub>. What comes out is the layer's output. <b>Equation 2.</b>" },
    { pill: "write / read", cls: "gd", dur: 3.2,
      cap: "So one set of weights plays two roles per step: the update writes this timestep into the parameters, the apply reads the history back out. Nothing is cached." }
  ];

  var STATE = {
    kv:     [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    q:      [0.22, 0.22, 0.22, 0.22, 1, 1],
    mlp:    [0.5, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1],
    boxOp:  [0.10, 0.10, 0.10, 0.34, 0.34, 0.34],
    wOld:   [1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0],
    wNew:   [0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1],
    arrKV:  [0, 1, 1, 1, 0.55, 1],
    vhat:   [0, 1, 1, 0.9, 0.3, 0.15],
    target: [0, 0, 1, 0.9, 0.3, 0.15],
    grad:   [0, 0, 0, 1, 0.55, 0.9],
    arrQ:   [0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1],
    out:    [0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1],
    write:  [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1],
    read:   [0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1]
  };

  var TOTAL = BEATS.reduce(function (a, b) { return a + b.dur; }, 0);
  var STARTS = [], acc = 0;
  BEATS.forEach(function (b) { STARTS.push(acc); acc += b.dur; });

  function easeIO(u) { return u * u * (3 - 2 * u); }

  function at(key, i) {
    if (i < 0) return key === "boxOp" ? STATE.boxOp[0] : 0;
    return STATE[key][i];
  }

  var pillEl = root.querySelector("#nv-pill");
  var capEl = root.querySelector("#nv-cap");
  var shown = -1;

  function render(T) {
    T = ((T % TOTAL) + TOTAL) % TOTAL;
    var i = 0;
    while (i < BEATS.length - 1 && T >= STARTS[i + 1]) i++;
    var u = easeIO(Math.min(1, (T - STARTS[i]) / (BEATS[i].dur * 0.42)));

    function set(key, node, attr) {
      var v = at(key, i - 1) + (at(key, i) - at(key, i - 1)) * u;
      node.setAttribute(attr || "opacity", v.toFixed(3));
    }
    set("kv", A.kv); set("q", A.q); set("mlp", A.mlp);
    set("wOld", A.wOld); set("wNew", A.wNew);
    set("arrKV", A.arrKV); set("arrQ", A.arrQ);
    set("vhat", A.vhat); set("target", A.target); set("grad", A.grad);
    set("out", A.out); set("write", A.write); set("read", A.read);
    set("boxOp", A.boxFill, "fill-opacity");

    if (i !== shown) {
      shown = i;
      pillEl.textContent = BEATS[i].pill;
      pillEl.className = "rttt-pill " + (BEATS[i].cls || "");
      capEl.innerHTML = BEATS[i].cap;
    }
  }

  /* ------------------------------------------------------------ controls */
  var playing = true, speed = 1, clock = 0, last = null, raf = null, dead = false;
  var bPlay = root.querySelector("#nv-play");
  var bStep = root.querySelector("#nv-step");
  var bRest = root.querySelector("#nv-restart");
  var sSpd = root.querySelector("#nv-speed");

  function setPlaying(on) {
    playing = on;
    bPlay.textContent = on ? "Pause" : "Play";
    bPlay.setAttribute("aria-label", on ? "Pause animation" : "Play animation");
  }
  bPlay.addEventListener("click", function () { setPlaying(!playing); });
  bStep.addEventListener("click", function () {
    setPlaying(false);
    var i = 0;
    while (i < BEATS.length - 1 && clock >= STARTS[i + 1]) i++;
    clock = STARTS[(i + 1) % BEATS.length] + 0.001;
    render(clock);
  });
  bRest.addEventListener("click", function () {
    clock = 0; setPlaying(true); render(0);
  });
  sSpd.addEventListener("change", function () { speed = parseFloat(sSpd.value); });

  var reduce = window.matchMedia &&
    window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)").matches;
  if (reduce) { clock = STARTS[BEATS.length - 1] + 0.001; setPlaying(false); }
  render(clock);

  if (window.IntersectionObserver) {
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (es) {
      es.forEach(function (e) {
        if (!e.isIntersecting && playing) setPlaying(false);
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.05 });
    io.observe(root);
  }

  raf = window.requestAnimationFrame(function tick(ts) {
    if (dead) return;
    if (last == null) last = ts;
    var dt = (ts - last) / 1000; last = ts;
    if (playing) { clock += dt * speed; render(clock); }
    raf = window.requestAnimationFrame(tick);
  });

  /* exposed so the deck can drive it from slide events */
  window.nvUpdateWidget = {
    beats: BEATS.length,
    restart: function () { clock = 0; setPlaying(true); render(0); },
    step: function () { bStep.click(); },
    pause: function () { setPlaying(false); },
    goto: function (i) {
      setPlaying(false);
      i = Math.max(0, Math.min(BEATS.length - 1, i | 0));
      clock = STARTS[i] + BEATS[i].dur * 0.5;
      render(clock);
    }
  };
})();

</script>
<p class="widget-credit own">Built for this talk; the paper states this in prose only.</p>
</div>
``````
